scope: Source/protocol investigation and pure regression tests only; no local native execution or completed Linux acceptance

findings.fact: Tauri features=[]; release action does not request devtools feature. Current 3.6.1 configuration likewise has no devtools feature.
WebViewAttributes defaults devtools=true under debug_assertions and false otherwise.
with_devtools call is compiled only under debug_assertions or feature=devtools.
enable-developer-extras is set only if attributes.devtools is true.
Initial automation=false is overridden by Tauri set_allows_automation when TAURI_WEBVIEW_AUTOMATION=true. Initial defaults alone do not establish release automation is disabled.

AppImage classification correlates bundle marker, APPIMAGE/APPDIR, executable and ELF/type-2 bytes. readonly policy reason is app-image-read-only; writable reason native-validation-pending. All targets remain null.
Finished event precedes successful awaited native download; downloaded-bytes resource is returned only after verification. No download is invoked by feasibility probe.
Explicit target is used verbatim as json_target. Future native calls must use linux-x86_64-appimage, never generic Linux target.
create_webview checks TAURI_WEBVIEW_AUTOMATION == true, then set_allows_automation(is_first_context), without a debug_assertions or devtools compile gate.
Automation-started sets wry application info and create-web-view returns the first created webview, not a new replacement. is-controlled-by-automation is separate from enable-developer-extras.

webkitgtk:browserOptions.targetAddress supplies targetAddr/targetPort. launchBrowser connects directly when targetIp is supplied. SessionHost filters targets for Automation and uses StartAutomationSession, not SetupInspectorClient. The unused pure attach payload uses /bin/false to fail closed if incompatible parsing ignores targetAddress; this probe never sends it.

--host=<host> and --port=<port> are supported. GET /status reports service availability only. The optional probe checks task-session IPv4-loopback listener ownership before requesting status, disables proxies/redirects, bounds time/bytes and never POSTs /session.

g_variant_byteswap returns a full, non-floating reference. Sinking it again leaks ownership. The fixed probe directly unrefs the returned full reference and retains documented pre-byteswap normal-form checking.

protocol: Native TCP framing: network-order u32 body size, u8 endian flag, NUL-terminated message name, GVariant parameters. SetupInspectorClient=(ay); SetTargetList to client=(ta(tsssb)). Not CDP and not an assumed WebSocket /json endpoint. WebKitWebDriver GET /status is HTTP on a separate service port, never sent to the inspector TCP port.
runtimeVersionCaveat: Actual AppImage-loaded WebKitGTK and hosted WebKitWebDriver may differ from reference 2.48.0. Availability does not establish compatibility/attachment. Hosted execution is required; protocol/setup/cleanup failures are nonzero. Missing inspector targets do not disprove independent automation.
result: Feasibility-only: exit 2 blocked/unexercised, exit 1 guard/setup/integrity/cleanup failure, never acceptance/pass. Native provenance/check/download/install/denial/replacement/relaunch and upgrade fixture preservation remain unexercised even if launch fixtures remain unchanged.

Driver rehashes size/digest, rejects symlink paths and checks ELF/type-2 AppImage bytes. Output linux-writable/linux-readonly must not already exist.

runnerRequirements.optionalWebDriverDiagnostic: webkit2gtk-driver provides WebKitWebDriver on sanitized PATH. Missing driver is recorded available=false, not core setup failure. Future attachment requires a version-compatible driver, not merely ready /status.
runnerRequirements.isolation: Python owns Xvfb/session DBus and task HOME/XDG/runtime/tmp, ignoring outer display/session wrappers. TAURI_WEBVIEW_AUTOMATION=true goes only to isolated child environment. No signing secrets, LD_PRELOAD, injected-bundle/executable overrides or host app data.
runnerRequirements.readonly: Disposable image and parent 0555 and effectively nonwritable by nonroot; native updater denial still unexercised.
runnerRequirements.upload: Upload caseRoot/linux-writable or linux-readonly recursively even on nonzero exit. Pre-output guard/manifest failures print stderr and may have no evidence directory; never infer acceptance from blocked diagnostics.

verdict.fact: The previous conclusion that disabled devtools prevents all release automation was incorrect. The baseline locks tauri-runtime-wry 2.9.3, whose TAURI_WEBVIEW_AUTOMATION=true opt-in is independent of debug/devtools. Wry supplies its first existing webview to automation; WebKitGTK targetAddress permits attachment without launching a replacement browser. This is a source-supported unmodified-release route, not actual AppImage runtime proof.
verdict.limitation: This bounded probe requests that mode, observes mounted provenance/native inspector, and optionally GETs a separate task-owned WebKitWebDriver /status. No WebDriver session creation, window selection, JavaScript evaluation, native IPC, download, installation or relaunch is implemented. Missing WebPage inspector targets with devtools disabled do not disprove the independent Automation route; a listener/target list/ready status is not app control.
verdict.nextGate: Hosted run 37783877938 isolates the mount allowlist rejection: correct owned leaders report fuse.Wallpaper.AppImage. Pure captured-evidence replay now correlates the exact expected-image filename subtype without wildcard FUSE acceptance. After review, a fresh approved hosted probe must verify this correction against genuine published 3.6.0. Only then can hosted evidence establish version-compatible targetAddress attachment to the observed AppImage-owned server and preserve the first existing webview without navigation/replacement before verifying packaged IPC identity. A control adapter and full updater acceptance are outside this bounded change. Never substitute MiniBrowser, a development webview or an extracted/rebuilt/patched executable.

referenceSources.fact: Runtime passes realpath(appimage_path) as FUSE argv[0], ro/offset options and mount directory, then calls fuse_parse_cmdline. Reference only: exact bundled runtime version is not identified.

libfuse 2.9.9 add_default_subtype derives subtype from argv[0] basename when fsname/subtype options do not suppress the default. Reference behavior supports the filename rule; hosted reports establish the actual observed type, not this library version.
